item.title: Solved: How to Upload Files Using Django Rest Framework
item.description:
File uploading in Django Rest Framework (DRF) is a common requirement but comes with its challenges. This guide provides answers to the most pressing questions and offers practical, step-by-step solutions tailored to developers using Django and AngularJS.

Key Questions Addressed

  1. How can you verify if request.FILES contains data in Django Rest Framework?
  2. What is the best approach to serialize file fields?
  3. When and how should you use parsers like MultiPartParser in DRF?

Solution 1: Using pre_save Hook (Deprecated)

Although pre_save is now deprecated in DRF 3.0+, understanding its usage is insightful for legacy projects.
